landing.heroDescription:
Chat with AI to plan your trip and
automatically create a shareable web itinerary.
landing.step1Desc: Share your destination, dates, and preferences naturally
landing.step2Desc: AI curates restaurants, attractions, and routes
landing.step3Desc: Auto-generate a complete schedule by time slot
landing.step4Desc: Share your itinerary with a single link
landing.destinationsDesc: Japan, Southeast Asia, Americas, Europe and more. Plan your trip with AI.
landing.feature1Desc: No overwhelming questions. The AI naturally guides you through planning step by step.
landing.feature2Desc: Verified data on hours, admission fees, transport, and local restaurants.
landing.feature3Desc: See AI responses appear in real-time. A natural conversational experience.
landing.feature4Desc: Just send a link to family and friends. They can view it instantly in their browser.
landing.faq1A: Yes, TripTalk is completely free. No login required — just start chatting with the AI to create your travel itinerary.
landing.faq2A: We support popular destinations worldwide including Japan (Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto), Southeast Asia (Bangkok, Bali, Da Nang), Europe (Paris, London, Barcelona), USA (New York, LA, Hawaii), and more.
landing.faq3A: Yes! Each itinerary gets a unique link you can easily share with family and friends. They can view it directly in their browser without installing any app.
landing.faq4A: TripTalk uses a structured local database to provide verified information on hours, fees, transport, and restaurants. However, local conditions may change, so we recommend confirming details before your visit.
landing.ctaDesc: No login, no cost. Create the perfect itinerary just by chatting with AI.
landing.errorToast: An error occurred. Please try again.
